description: React component for editing and printing bills, managing bill data, fetching billing history, updating bill details, and generating printable bill HTML.

methods.name: updateHistory
methods.description: Sends updated bill data to backend API to update billing history.

methods.name: fetchHistory
methods.description: Fetches billing history list from backend API.

methods.name: onSearchHandler
methods.description: Searches for a bill by bill number in the billing history.

methods.name: changeBill
methods.description: Updates bill state with new field values.

methods.name: handleQuantityChange
methods.description: Updates product quantity, recalculates total amount and savings.

methods.name: handlePrint
methods.description: Generates and opens a printable HTML version of the bill.
